_comment: RETURN_TO_HAND returned THIS card -- the source -- so 'put THEM into your hand' meant the Tome. The payoff was also wrapped in a SEARCH_DECK gated on CARD_IN_ZONE zone 'REVEALED', a player zone that does not exist, and REVEAL_TOP_DECK stored the revealed cards nowhere. Now it stores them under a ref and asks REF_CONTAINS_TYPE about the SET: REF_IS_TYPE collapses a list to its last entry, which on a two-card reveal tests one card twice.
